Package Data.Controllers.NoDBCtrl

Class EnquestaCtrlNoDB

java.lang.Object
Data.Controllers.NoDBCtrl.EnquestaCtrlNoDB
All Implemented Interfaces:
IEnquestaCtrl
public class EnquestaCtrlNoDB extends Object implements IEnquestaCtrl
In-memory implementation of the Enquesta controller without database persistence. Manages Enquesta instances using a Dictionary data structure.
